verdict.rationale: Gumloop's Human in the Loop docs say agents can pause and ask for permission before an action. Tool approval settings let you require sign-off for sensitive operations such as sending emails or deleting records, and an Ask Question ability lets the agent request human input before continuing. Missing for 10: details on how approvals are surfaced and resolved during unattended triggered or scheduled runs (notifications, timeouts), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
